_comment: Template only. Illustrates permission-mode settings shapes — no secrets, no real repo paths. Adapt keys/values to your actual settings schema/version before use.

example_project_default_plan_mode._use_case: New/unfamiliar repo: default every session into Plan mode so nothing edits source until a plan is approved.

example_ci_locked_down._use_case: Scripted/CI run: only pre-approved tools execute, nothing prompts because nothing is watching.

example_trusted_iteration._use_case: Fast local iteration on non-critical code: accept routine file edits, still ask for anything else.

example_disable_bypass_org_wide._use_case: Org policy: never allow bypassPermissions mode, even in a session that requests it.

example_auto_mode_trust_scope._use_case: Auto mode: extend classifier trust to one extra internal registry/domain beyond the working repo.
